description: Evaluate a SysML expression against a parsed model (the Evaluate RPC, the REPL's %eval): arithmetic, feature reads, quantities with units, collection operators. The result is the EvaluateResponse as protojson writes it: `result` is a Value (64-bit integers are JSON strings, as the proto3 JSON mapping writes them), `error` is set when the expression could not be evaluated. The text spells the value as the REPL prints it.

contextSymbolId.description: qualified name of the namespace the expression's names resolve in; empty is the model root

expression.description: the SysML expression, as 2 + 2 or Demo::sedan.mass

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

subjectSymbolId.description: qualified name of a part/usage to instantiate and evaluate against, so a feature reads that object's value rather than its declared default

name: evaluate
